title: Full Throttle! The Speed Queen Can't Stop

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Uooooooohhhhh!!
Trainer straight ahead!! Watch out!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SKREEEEEECH!!*)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's pedestrian status, clear. Zero collision incidents, clear.
Pardon the disturbance.
choice_data_list: W-Why are you in such a huge rush?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I rush because there is a reason to rush.
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah!
Wait for me, kitieeeeeeesss!!!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*... L-Light O~! I'm not done talki—*cough*!
That cat cafe is... closed today~~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she dashed off to the cat cafe without knowing it was closed.
I tried to call her, but couldn't get through at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Left with no choice, I hailed a taxi to speed after her
to the cat cafe in the neighboring town—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...How can this be? This is too cruel.
To think that even with maximum speed, I cannot meet the kitties...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...However, I shall not falter. I will not break. I will not surrender.
The shortest path to meeting kitties does not lie here.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The fastest way to see them right now is...
The park kitties!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*plop*)
choice_data_list: ...Wait, you dropped your wallet?! Hey, hold up!!
...Wait, you dropped your wallet?! Hey, hold up!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So cute, so cute, so cute, so cute!
Good kitty, good kitty, purr-purr-purr-purr!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* If only I could huff your fur...
But we have not yet established that level of mutual trust...
choice_data_list: Light O! You dropped your wal—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Then! I simply must go to a kitty who will allow me to huff it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow! Ouch... Rear-paw bunny kicks.
However, this is adorable in its own right, so clear. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Oh, right, Light O-chan.
Have you met the cat stationmaster at the nearby station? He's round and cute as a daifuku mochi~.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The next bus to the station with the cat stationmaster is... What? In one hour?
A waste of precious time! I will simply run there!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That is... the earlier bus that already departed!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Not on my watch, big guy!
I'm gonna be the first one to meet the Cat Stationmaster!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: This straight-line showdown is miiiiine!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kitty, kitty, kitty~ Kit-kit-kit~
...A hymn to praise felines. If I do say so myself, it is an absolute masterpiece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to keep up with Calstone Light O, I waited at the school gate for several hours.
Finally, she returned.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. For some reason today, you resemble either
a zombie or a strip of dehydrated seaweed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to tell you an invigorating tale.
It is about kitties. Breathe in the feline energy.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
People lump them all together as kitties, but no two kitties are identical.
All different, all wonderful, yet fundamentally all kitties.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This realization came solely because I rushed to meet them at top speed.
It was a fruitful cat pilgrimage. ...So, what brings you here, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I wanted to return the wallet you dropped.
I wanted to return the wallet you dropped.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ............Blast it all!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I was on the verge of making another blunder.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When I drop something, it almost never comes back.
Because I am fast. Too fast—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To be the fastest means absolute top speed. Ergo, no one can catch up.
Waiting here was a sound tactical decision.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *Applause.*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she moves far too fast, nobody can ever keep pace with Calstone Light O.
Will the day ever come when I can operate at the exact same speed as her—?
